segments.title: 第53章 送小布丁
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Era, Chapter 53: Delivering Xiaobuding

Li Luo now had quite a bit of prestige in the class.

It wasn't just as simple as being given a belt in the morning.

The key thing was, everyone was wearing the same army-green military training uniform and a hat.

If they were walking in a crowd, even their own dorm mates might not be able to recognize them at a glance.

But in the morning, Li Luo had stood in the bus carriage and had always been able to spot them at a glance, then call out their names with unerring accuracy.

It was a very strange feeling.

So when Li Luo called out, many people subconsciously stood up.

Zhu Yufei was the first to follow. Zhang Guohuang and Wei Chun, who had just sat down, immediately got up and walked toward Li Luo.

Several other boys followed out of curiosity.

Seeing this, Xu Yinghuan quickly pulled Jin Yuting over to watch the excitement. "What are Li Luo and the others doing?"

"I don't know," Jin Yuting said, looking puzzled. "That's the school wall over there, right? Why are they walking that way?"

Without much explanation, Li Luo walked quickly to the wall and greeted Lin Xiufeng, who had been waiting for a long time. "Uncle, thanks for your hard work."

"It's nothing." Lin Xiufeng smiled and turned to move things from his vehicle. There were three large boxes in total, all wrapped in styrofoam.

The friend Lin Xiufeng had called over to help stood by, steadying him. Lin Xiufeng stepped onto a crevice at the edge of the wall, picked up a box, and passed it over.

"Zhu Yufei, come give me a hand." Li Luo patted Zhu Yufei's shoulder. "You're tall, get up there and take it. We'll hold you steady."

"Alright!" Zhu Yufei had already figured it out. The boxes were probably full of drinks. He excitedly stepped onto the wall, easily took the box, and then handed it to Zhang Guohuang next to him.

After three such handovers, everything had been received.

"Alright, I'm off to my own business. Call me if you need anything." Lin Xiufeng didn't linger. With the goods delivered, he waved goodbye and left.

After seeing Lin Xiufeng off, Li Luo smiled and called his classmates over to help move the three boxes to Class 8's assembly point.

The students who hadn't followed and were resting where they were, all looked over, their gazes filled with curiosity.

By now, Li Luo had already opened the boxes. Inside were all sorts of drinks, including Coke, Sprite, Mizone, Scream, Gatorade, and Red Bull.

The styrofoam boxes were also filled with ice packs, ensuring that when the boxes were opened, the drinks inside were still chilled.

"Take whatever you want to drink, there's one for everyone in our class." As Li Luo spoke, he opened the last box.

This box wasn't filled with drinks, but with Xiaobuding ice pops, a full fifty of them in the box.

"There are also Xiaobuding over here. Everyone take one and eat it soon, they'll melt if you leave them out for too long."

"Long live the Class Monitor!" The most rambunctious of them, Zhang Guohuang, unceremoniously grabbed a Xiaobuding and raised it high above his head, cheering.

"Awesome, Class Monitor, I could just die for you."

"Haha, I'm going to go show off to the other classes."

"You better watch out, you might get beaten up."

While the boys were joking around, the girls walked over in a group.

Xu Yinghuan picked out a bottle of her favorite drink and a Xiaobuding, then said sweetly to Li Luo, "Thank you, Mr. Class Monitor~"

Hua Xiuxiu stood to the side, holding the drink and Xiaobuding that Lin Yuan had gotten for her, a complicated look in her eyes.

For someone of her family's means, buying drinks and ice pops for the whole class would only cost one or two hundred yuan, a price she could afford.

But before the military training began, she truly hadn't thought of such a method, let alone put it into action.

"Help me hand these out, I have something else to do," Li Luo said to Zhu Yufei after taking a few drinks and Xiaobuding from the box.

After saying that, he walked toward Class 1 and Class 3.

...

When Class 1 took their break, because they were relatively close to the canteen's tuck shop, many people rushed there at once, planning to buy some drinks or ice pops.

Liu Shaowen was also among the first to dash out, buying two cold drinks while in line.

"Can you finish two bottles?" Liao Hailin, who was beside him, couldn't help but ask. "We have dinner in another two hours."

"Who said I was going to drink them all myself?" Liu Shaowen shook his head with a chuckle. "I just saw that Ying Chanxi didn't come to buy a drink, so I'm getting one for her."

"Tsk, tsk." Liao Hailin tutted repeatedly. "Didn't you say before that Ying Chanxi definitely wouldn't date in high school? So why are you bothering?"

"What do you know?" Liu Shaowen glanced at him and said with a straight face, "It's this kind of subtle, nurturing companionship that's needed. After three years of high school, as long as I can get into the same university as her, this companionship will naturally become the nourishment for a relationship."

"..." Liao Hailin was stunned by his theory. It actually seemed to make a lot of sense. "You're amazing. I'm no match for you."

After buying their drinks, the two of them headed back towards Class 1.

But as they neared their class's area, Liu Shaowen deliberately slowed his pace, to make it seem like he wasn't intentionally doing anything, just simply helping to buy a drink on the way.

He had already thought of his lines.

In their class, the two of them were the only students from Yucai High School, so it was only right to help each other out from time to time.

Since he already bought it, she could just drink it. If she felt bad about it, she could treat him back next time.

And just like that, wouldn't they have an interaction?

As Liu Shaowen fantasized, his mood grew buoyant, and his steps became a bit lighter.

But when he looked over at Ying Chanxi, just as he was about to walk over to give her the drink, his steps came to a sudden halt.

He saw a boy, holding a drink and an ice pop, walk up behind Ying Chanxi and, while she wasn't looking, ambush her tender cheek with the ice-cold bottle.

Startled, Ying Chanxi turned her head. After seeing who the boy was, she swatted at him with a coquettish pout, then accepted the drink and ice pop from him.

Seeing this, Liu Shaowen fell silent.

Liao Hailin, at his side, also fell silent.

But Liao Hailin hadn't really put in any real effort, so his state of shock was shorter. He didn't forget to offer some comfort, "We saw that guy in the canteen before. He's Ying Chanxi's cousin, right?"

Liu Shaowen nodded helplessly. He could only secretly rejoice that the one who delivered the drink was that Li Luo, and not some other boy.

But he also believed that if any other boy had offered her a drink, Ying Chanxi would have most likely just refused.

"So, are you still giving her this drink?" Liao Hailin glanced at the two bottles in his hand and asked.

"...I'll give it to her tomorrow!"

...

"Is it good?"

Watching the Xiaobuding melt in Ying Chanxi's mouth, Li Luo squatted beside her and asked.

Ying Chanxi glanced at him. "It's so-so."

"I risked my life to bring you this stuff, and this is how you treat me?"

"Why was your life at risk? It's not like I'm going to eat you."

"But the glares from the boys in your class are about to eat me alive."

"Don't be so dramatic." Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes at him.

Li Luo grinned and glanced at the boys around them, then handed another Xiaobuding to Qiao Xinyan next to her. "You're her deskmate, right? Thanks for taking care of my cousin recently."

"Oh, oh, thanks," Qiao Xinyan said, delighted to receive a Xiaobuding herself. "It's always Xixi taking care of me. I don't take care of her."

"Don't listen to his nonsense," Ying Chanxi bit off her Xiaobuding in a huff. "I was born a day before him. He's supposed to call me older sister."
